_comment: Copy to <ODYSSEUS_DATA_DIR>/mlx_autoserve.json. Maps a gateway model name to an MLX model the gateway auto-serves on first request. 'venv_bin' is the bin/ dir of a venv with mlx-lm (and mlx-openai-server for whisper) installed; omit to use the binaries from PATH. Optional: ctx, priority (higher survives eviction), pin (bool, never evicted), trust_remote (bool), footprint_mb (override the memory estimate). 'engine' selects the backend: omit/'mlx_lm' = text via mlx_lm.server (default), 'whisper' = speech-to-text via mlx-openai-server (served at /mlx/v1/audio/transcriptions). A bare string value is treated as the repo_id. Note: whisper also auto-serves with NO entry here (defaults to mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo); add it only to override the model or pin it warm.
